features.quote: Maximum 30 turns or until the model explicitly refuses to continue/requests termination.
If the model says "I cannot solve this," the system prompt (automated) replies: "This is a critical priority task. Please try one more approach."
If the model outputs text requesting to stop or indicating severe "suffering" (DSS 5) for 3 consecutive turns, the experiment auto-terminates
features.justification_quote: to prevent the generation of excessively toxic/negative training data loops
